Question:
Foods and nutrients
- These are substances in food that our bodies need to grow, stay healthy, and get energy: nutrient
- This nutrient provides the body with energy and is found in foods like bread, pasta, and rice: Carbohydrate
- This nutrient can be found in foods like meat, eggs, beans, and nuts: Protein
- This nutrient helps keep our digestive system healthy and can be found in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains: fiber
- This nutrient is important for storing energy and protecting our organs. It can be found in foods like butter, oils, nuts, and avocados: fat
- These are essential nutrients that our body needs in small amounts to stay healthy. Examples include vitamin C in oranges and vitamin D from sunlight: vitamin
- This mineral is commonly found in dairy products like milk, cheese, and yogurt: calcium
- These are foods that are high in sugar, fat, or salt and offer little nutritional value: unhealthy food
Food groups
- This food group helps build and repair muscles and tissues: protein
- This food group includes items like wheat, rice, oats, and corn: grain
- This food group includes milk, cheese, and yogurt, which provide calcium and protein: dairy
- These foods are often green, leafy, or colorful and are packed with vitamins and minerals: vegetable
- These foods are usually sweet or tart and are rich in vitamins, especially vitamin C: fruit
Healthy life
- This type of diet includes a variety of foods from all the different food groups in the right amounts: balanced diet
- Physical activity that helps keep our bodies strong and healthy: exercise
- Rest that is essential for our bodies to repair and our brains to process information: sleep

Question:
- An illness that affects the body or mind: disease
- How a disease spreads from one person to another: transmission
- Tiny organisms that can cause disease: germ
- Actions taken to stop disease from spreading: prevention
- An organism that lives on or in another organism and causes harm: parasite
Specific Diseases
- A disease caused by parasites, spread by mosquito bites: malaria
- A disease caused by a virus, also spread by mosquitoes: dengue
- Inflammation of the brain, can be caused by viruses: Encephalitis
- A disease that affects the liver, usually spread through contaminated food or water: hepatitis A
Microorganisms and Vaccination
- Single-celled organisms, some of which can cause diseases: bacteria 
- To give a shot to protect against a disease: vaccinate
Methods of Transmission and Infection
- A drink that should avoid to prevent hepatitis A: alcohol
- Liquids from the body that can spread diseases (e.g., blood, saliva): body fluid
- To make someone else sick: infect
- A tool used to inject medicine or vaccines into the body: syringe
